title: Bead Beating RNA Extraction from 25 mm Filter
author: Christa Smith
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.jx6cpre
materials: Quantify extracted RNA with Nanodrop (2 μl)
Quantify DNased RNA with Nanodrop (2 μl)

steps.title: Start 4°C centrifuge
steps.instruction: Turn on the centrifuge and set the temperature to 4 °C.

steps.title: Set up vortex adaptor
steps.instruction: Attach the 2.0 ml tube adaptor to the Mo Bio Vortex Genie 2.

steps.title: Prepare bead mixture
steps.instruction: In each 2.0 ml tube add 200 µL 0.1 mm zirconium beads, 100 µL 0.4–0.6 mm glass beads, and 100 µL 0.5 mm zirconium beads (3‑bead mixture, per Christa Smith).

steps.title: Add denaturation solution
steps.instruction: Add Ambion Denaturation Solution (Thermo Scientific Cat #AM8540G) to each tube (volume as per kit instructions).

steps.title: Add internal standards
steps.instruction: Add internal standards to each tube to reach approximately 0.5 % of the expected RNA yield.

steps.title: Insert sample filter
steps.instruction: Using RNase‑free forceps, place one 25 mm sample filter into each bead tube.

steps.title: Bead‑beat samples
steps.instruction: Place the tubes on the vortex adaptor and beat for 5 min; then switch tube positions and beat for an additional 5 min.

substeps.instruction: Place tubes on vortex adaptor and beat for 5 min.
Switch tube positions and beat for another 5 min.

steps.title: Centrifuge lysates (first spin)
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes for 1 min at 5,000 rpm, 4 °C.

steps.title: Transfer RNA lysate
steps.instruction: Transfer as much RNA lysate as possible to a new 1.5 ml centrifuge tube (beads may carry over).

steps.title: Second centrifugation of lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the RNA tubes for 5 min at 5,000 rpm, 4 °C.

steps.title: Transfer lysate to clean tube
steps.instruction: Transfer the clarified lysate to a new 2.0 ml tube, avoiding any beads.

steps.title: Add ethanol to lysate
steps.instruction: Add one volume of 100 % ethanol (Merck MilliporeSigma Cat #E7023) to the lysate.

steps.title: Shear RNA with syringe
steps.instruction: Draw the lysate into a 3.0 ml syringe fitted with a 21 g 1 gauge needle and pass it back out eight times to shear the RNA.

steps.title: Load lysate onto RNeasy column
steps.instruction: Apply 700 µL of the lysate to a RNeasy Mini column (Qiagen Cat #74104), close gently, and centrifuge 15 s at 13,000 rpm. Repeat loading until all lysate has been applied.

substeps.instruction: Repeat until entire sample is loaded.

steps.title: Wash column with Buffer RW1
steps.instruction: Add 700 µL Buffer RW1 to the spin column, centrifuge 15 s at 13,000 rpm, and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Wash column with Buffer RPE
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL Buffer RPE, centrifuge 15 s at 13,000 rpm and discard flow‑through; add a second 500 µL Buffer RPE and centrifuge 2 min at 13,000 rpm.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL Buffer RPE, centrifuge 15 s at 13,000 rpm, discard flow‑through.
Add second 500 µL Buffer RPE, centrifuge 2 min at 13,000 rpm.

steps.title: Finalize column and prepare for elution
steps.instruction: Place the column in a new 2.0 ml collection tube, centrifuge 1 min at 13,000 rpm, then transfer the column to a new 1.5 ml sterile tube.

substeps.instruction: Place column in new 2.0 ml collection tube.
Move column to new 1.5 ml sterile tube.

steps.title: First RNA elution
steps.instruction: Add 35 µL RNase‑free water directly onto the filter, incubate 1 min at room temperature, then centrifuge 1 min at 13,000 rpm.

substeps.instruction: Add 35 µL RNase‑free water onto filter.

steps.title: Second RNA elution
steps.instruction: Add another 35 µL RNase‑free water, incubate 1 min at room temperature, and centrifuge 1 min at 13,000 rpm.

steps.title: Place RNA on ice
steps.instruction: Discard the column and keep the tube containing the eluted RNA on ice.

steps.title: Set up DNase reaction
steps.instruction: In a 1.5 ml tube combine 50 µL RNA, 40 µL DNase reaction buffer, and 10 µL Turbo DNase (Thermo Scientific Cat #AM1907); incubate 20 min at 37 °C.

steps.title: Add second DNase aliquot
steps.instruction: Add 3 µL additional Turbo DNase to the reaction and incubate another 20 min at 37 °C.

steps.title: Inactivate DNase
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL DNase inactivation solution, vortex on/off for ~4 min, then spin 1 min at 13,000 rpm.

steps.title: Recover RNA after inactivation
steps.instruction: Carefully remove ~100 µL supernatant without disturbing the inactivation reagent, transfer to a new 1.5 ml tube, and place on ice.

steps.title: Optional RNA clean‑up
steps.instruction: If desired, clean and concentrate the DNase‑treated RNA using Zymo RNA Clean & Concentrator‑5 (Catalog #R1015) according to the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Store RNA at –80°C
steps.instruction: Store the purified RNA at –80 °C until further use.
